messages:
Cecilia Ramos: Quick post-all-hands capture: pulling together the customer wins/losses themes and the concrete asks we should feed to Eng/PM.

Omar Hussein: From deal reviews: wins = reliable burst handling + predictable per-token cost reports. Losses = no BYO-KMS in VPC + missing cross-region failover guarantees for EU customers.

Kevin Lu: Also saw requests for a security matrix doc. Procurement teams keep asking for a simple checklist: certifications + support for BYO-KMS + data residency. Sales says that's a gating item.

Maya Singh: CS flag: several customers want an "eval rollback" hook in Console so they can auto-block bad deployments when eval metrics drop. They see this as a low-friction safety control.

Omar Hussein: Leadership question: which of these are Q1 musts? My take: 1) BYO-KMS in VPC + audit export (Q1), 2) Security matrix + residency policy doc (Q1), 3) Eval rollback hook (prototype Q1, GA Q3), 4) Cross-region guarantees (Q2).

Cecilia Ramos: Can Eng/Infra confirm the main blockers for BYO-KMS and cross-region failover? Any estimate on effort? @ops-bot can you summarize infra tickets?

ops-bot: Infra summary: INF-700 (KMS proxy auth), INF-701 (audit-export durability), INF-712 (multi-region routing policy). Status: INF-700/701 in backlog; INF-712 design needed. Rough ETA if prioritized: 4-8 weeks.

Kevin Lu: Sales asks for a one-page "security + roadmap" handout they can drop in RFPs. Also want an example contract clause for data residency. Can Docs/Legal produce asap?

Maya Singh: Action items I captured: 1) Eng infra comment with blockers + ETA by Thu EOD; 2) PM/Legal draft security matrix + residency clause by next Wed; 3) DevEx publish eval-rollback prototype guide & sample canary config in two sprints; 4) Ops create cross-region test plan.

Omar Hussein: Quick wins for next two weeks: publish recommended canary percentages, add prefix-caching example to SDK samples, and a short FAQ about what we support today vs roadmap.

Cecilia Ramos: Leadership ask: confirm priority order and whether to reallocate 1-2 infra engineers to accelerate INF-700/701. If Execs agree, we'll surface a timeline to customers.

Kevin Lu: Here's a paraphrased customer quote we can use (anonymized): "We need clear residency and key control to get past procurement."

Maya Singh: I'll collate quotes and drop into this thread. Also will attach a short reproducible test case for a streaming burst we saw that produced p99 spikes.

Cecilia Ramos: Thanks all  I'll draft the all-hands blurb once infra confirms ETA. Posting summary to #product shortly.

Omar Hussein: :thumbsup:

Kevin Lu: End of thread for now, will follow up in #sales-docs when the one-pager is ready.
